_readme: Genre embedding pack (source: acousticbrainz-ppmi (1958394 recordings; MediaEval AcousticBrainz Genre Dataset, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)). Cosine similarity between vectors approximates genre relatedness. Regenerate with scripts/build-genre-embedding.mjs.
